description: Brake subsystem (owner: Khoa): brake pads, hydraulic circuit (fluid level, leaks, air, old fluid), brake disc and caliper.

question.vi: Phanh kêu rít hoặc két khi bóp phanh?
question.en: Do the brakes squeal or squeak when applied?

question.vi: Phanh kêu ken két như sắt cọ vào sắt khi bóp phanh?
question.en: Is there a metal-on-metal grinding noise when braking?

question.vi: Nhìn qua khe cùm phanh thấy má phanh đã mỏng, gần chạm lớp sắt hoặc vạch báo mòn?
question.en: Looking through the caliper, are the brake pads thin, close to the metal backing or the wear mark?

hint.vi: Tắt máy, chờ phanh nguội rồi dùng đèn pin soi vào khe giữa cùm phanh và đĩa.
hint.en: Switch the engine off, let the brakes cool, then look into the gap of the caliper with a torch.

question.vi: Tay phanh (hoặc cần phanh) mềm, phải bóp sâu mới ăn?
question.en: Does the brake lever feel soft or spongy, needing a deep pull before the brakes bite?

question.vi: Mức dầu phanh trong bình dầu thấp hơn vạch thấp nhất (LOWER / MIN)?
question.en: Is the brake fluid in the reservoir below the lower (LOWER / MIN) mark?

hint.vi: Giữ xe thẳng đứng và tay lái thẳng khi nhìn mức dầu qua ô kính.
hint.en: Keep the motorbike upright with the handlebar straight when you read the level.

question.vi: Thấy dầu phanh rỉ ướt ở dây dầu, cùm phanh hoặc bình dầu?
question.en: Do you see brake fluid leaking at the brake hose, the caliper or the reservoir?

question.vi: Dầu phanh đã quá hạn thay theo sổ bảo dưỡng, hoặc bạn không nhớ lần thay gần nhất?
question.en: Is the brake fluid overdue for replacement in the maintenance schedule, or you cannot remember when it was last changed?

question.vi: Khi phanh có cảm giác rung hoặc giật ở tay phanh, chân phanh hoặc tay lái?
question.en: Do you feel vibration or pulsing in the brake lever, pedal or handlebar when braking?

question.vi: Phanh ăn kém hơn trước, xe phải đi xa hơn mới dừng?
question.en: Are the brakes weaker than before, so the motorbike needs a longer distance to stop?

question.vi: Sau khi nhả phanh, bánh xe vẫn nặng, nóng hoặc có tiếng cọ nhẹ như bị phanh kéo?
question.en: After releasing the brake, does the wheel still feel heavy, hot or rub lightly as if the brake is dragging?

description.vi: Mạch dầu phanh bị hụt dầu
description.en: Brake hydraulic circuit has lost fluid

action.vi: Thay má phanh sớm, không nên chạy tiếp vì phanh sẽ kém và có thể làm xước đĩa phanh.
action.en: Replace the brake pads soon; do not keep riding, as braking gets weaker and the disc can be scored.

action.vi: Ngừng chạy và mang xe ra tiệm ngay để kiểm tra dây dầu, phớt cùm phanh, heo dầu; hệ thống phanh có thể mất tác dụng.
action.en: Stop riding and go to a repair shop at once to check the hose, caliper seals and master cylinder; the brakes may fail.

name.vi: Lọt khí trong đường dầu phanh

action.vi: Mang xe ra tiệm xả e (xả khí) và bổ sung hoặc thay dầu phanh; kiểm tra luôn chỗ rò nếu mức dầu hụt.
action.en: Have the brakes bled at a repair shop and the fluid topped up or replaced; check for leaks if the level has dropped.

name.vi: Dầu phanh cũ hoặc nhiễm ẩm

action.vi: Thay dầu phanh đúng loại hãng quy định và xả e hệ thống tại tiệm.
action.en: Replace the brake fluid with the type specified by the manufacturer and bleed the system at a repair shop.

action.vi: Mang xe ra tiệm đo độ dày và độ cong đĩa phanh; đĩa vênh thường phải thay.
action.en: Have the disc thickness and runout measured at a repair shop; a warped disc usually has to be replaced.

action.vi: Mang xe ra tiệm vệ sinh hoặc thay cùm phanh; nếu để lâu có thể làm nóng, vênh đĩa và hỏng má phanh.
action.en: Have the caliper cleaned or replaced at a repair shop; left alone it can overheat and warp the disc and ruin the pads.

rules.source: Demon Tweeks blog, "Motorcycle Brake Issues - Causes and Fixes", https://blog.demon-tweeks.com/motorcycle/motorcycle-brake-issues-causes-and-fixes/; Lazada PH practical guide, "How to tell if your motorcycle brake caliper needs replacement", https://auto.lazada.com.ph/how-to-tell-if-your-motorcycle-brake-caliper-needs-replacement-ph/
rules.note: Squealing is the pad wear indicator; seeing thin pads confirms it.

rules.source: Kass & Moses, "6 Tips to Know if Your Motorcycle Brakes are Going Bad", https://kassandmoses.com/blog/6-tips-to-know-if-your-motorcycle-brakes-are-going-bad/
rules.note: Grinding usually means the friction material is gone and metal touches the disc.

rules.source: Demon Tweeks blog, "Motorcycle Brake Issues - Causes and Fixes", https://blog.demon-tweeks.com/motorcycle/motorcycle-brake-issues-causes-and-fixes/
rules.note: Weaker evidence than BR01: squeal can also come from glazed pads or dust.

rules.source: Demon Tweeks blog, "Motorcycle Brake Issues - Causes and Fixes", https://blog.demon-tweeks.com/motorcycle/motorcycle-brake-issues-causes-and-fixes/

rules.note: A spongy lever points to air or moisture in the fluid; brake fluid absorbs moisture over time.

rules.source: Demon Tweeks blog, "Motorcycle Brake Issues - Causes and Fixes", https://blog.demon-tweeks.com/motorcycle/motorcycle-brake-issues-causes-and-fixes/
rules.note: Fluid leaks lower the level and let air into the circuit.

rules.source: Kass & Moses, "6 Tips to Know if Your Motorcycle Brakes are Going Bad", https://kassandmoses.com/blog/6-tips-to-know-if-your-motorcycle-brakes-are-going-bad/
rules.note: Weak evidence: a spongy lever is caused either by air or by worn pads.

rules.note: Dragging brakes overheat the disc, which makes it warp.
